title: varronia multicapitata
intro: Varronia multicapitata, commonly known as Mbololo or African teak, is a plant species native to West Africa. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of Varronia multicapitata include alkaloids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Its leaves and bark are often used in traditional medicine, highlighting the plant's potential as a source of natural remedies.
